subject: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — MedLytics trial
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Burke <sam.burke@medlytics.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — MedLytics trial

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the context on the recommendation pipeline and the latency targets you mentioned (~150ms P50 for inference on short prompts). Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get the evaluation started next week: 

Recap (from our side):
- Goal: improve personalized recommendations and reduce inference cost per 1k requests.
- Success criteria you mentioned: P50 latency <= 150ms, endpoint throughput 600 req/s, and embedding similarity recall >= 92% on the seed prompt set.
- Data: you’ll be testing on a 5M-row product catalog snapshot and a set of 1.2k evaluation prompts.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule an evaluation kickoff (60–75 min) that combines a short trial plan walkthrough and a technical deep dive (connectors, data ingestion, auth, and perf expectations).
2) Agree on the trial plan and prompt set / eval harness. I attached a TrialPlan skeleton (CSV) — please add columns for any additional metrics you want tracked.
3) Confirm participants: we suggest including someone from security for the SOC2/data handling bit; I’ve copied Priya if available.

Availability (all times PT):
- Mon 14 Sep: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:00
- Tue 15 Sep: 09:00–10:15 or 16:00–17:00
- Wed 16 Sep: 11:00–12:15

Can you confirm which slot works and who on your side should be on the call? Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in Vivek for the deep-dive portion.

Attachments: MedLytics_TrialPlan_Skeleton.csv

—
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sam Burke <sam.burke@medlytics.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medlytics.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — MedLytics trial

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our internal view. A couple of clarifications before we lock a time:
- Security: Priya (cc’d) will handle SOC2/data questions — she’ll want the standard questionnaire and a contact for a technical security call.
- Data pipeline: we plan to run the evaluation from our staging cluster and can provide a DB dump + sample API if needed. We prefer a 75-minute session to cover perf tuning.

Availability (ET):
- Tue 15 Sep: 13:00–14:30 ET (that matches your Tue 09:00–10:30 PT slot) — works for Sam and Priya.
- Wed 16 Sep: morning is tight for us.

Can Vivek run through the connector options and expected infra for a 600 req/s sustained load? Also, are you able to send a short list of what we should prepare from our end (format examples for the catalog, auth tokens, and whether we need to create a staging role)?

If Tue 15 Sep 13:00 ET works, please send the invite and include a pre-call checklist.

Thanks —
Sam
Head of ML Engineering | MedLytics
sam.burke@medlytics.io | +1 (646) 555-7821
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Burke <sam.burke@medlytics.io>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medlytics.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 20:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — MedLytics trial

Great — Tue 15 Sep 13:00–14:15 ET / 10:00–11:15 PT reservation noted (75 minutes). I’ve tentatively held that slot in our calendar and will send a formal invite once I confirm with Vivek.

Prep checklist (short):
- Staging access: DB dump + service account that allows read-only access OR sample export (CSV) with the same schema; include a small sample of product embeddings if available.
- Prompt set: the 1.2k prompts you mentioned (CSV) and labeling for success/failure where available.
- Performance target: your baseline perf numbers (P50/P95) and expected concurrency pattern.
- Security: Priya, please share the SOC2 questionnaire link and preferred NDA/SLA contacts — we’ll provide the security contact for the technical call.

Vivek — can you lead the technical deep dive and outline the connector options (S3 import vs API streaming), quantization/instance sizing recommendations for our target throughput, and a baseline perf run we can do during the session?

Attachments: MedLytics_SOW_v0.1.pdf (SOW draft for internal planning — rough)

—
Neha
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Action: prep for MedLytics evaluation kickoff (Tue 15 Sep)

Team —

MedLytics confirmed Tue 15 Sep 13:00–14:15 ET for the evaluation kickoff. High level asks from the call: perf plan, connector options, trial metrics tracking, and a short security touchpoint.

Immediate action items (owner / due):
- Vivek: prepare 20–25 minute technical deep dive deck (connectors, recommended instance profiles, quantization notes) + a short perf checklist we can run in-session. Due EOD Mon 14 Sep.
- Marissa: draft a mutual action plan (timeline + milestones for the 4-week trial) and populate the TrialPlan CSV with the 1.2k prompt set placeholder. Due Mon 14 Sep 18:00 PT.
- Jonas: create a HubSpot timeline entry and attach the SOW stub; prefill deal stage and ARR estimate (I’ll share numbers offline). Due Mon 14 Sep EOD.

I’ll compile materials and send the calendar invite and pre-read links Monday morning. If there are blockers (access to docs, questions on perf assumptions), flag them here.

Thanks —
Neha
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
